name: blog-google
description: > Credentialed Google API calls for a blog: PageSpeed Insights, CrUX history, Search Console performance and URL Inspection, GA4 organic traffic, Cloud NLP entities, YouTube video search, Google Ads Keyword Planner, and the Indexing API (job and livestream pages only). Uses the user's Google credentials, quotas, and sometimes billing, and asks for consent before the first call.
